projects.title: Interactive Developer Portfolio
projects.description: A modern, fully responsive personal portfolio featuring a modular tab-based navigation system. Built with a focus on clean UI/UX, reusable components, and smooth animations to effectively showcase my academic journey, career tracks, and software projects.

projects.title: SMS Spam Detection
projects.description: A robust Natural Language Processing (NLP) pipeline engineered for automated SMS spam classification. This project implements a custom, scratch-built NumPy-based K-Nearest Neighbors (KNN) classifier paired with TF-IDF vectorization and data balancing strategies, achieving an impressive 0.926 macro F1-score.

projects.title: PySocket Chat System
projects.description: A multi-client real-time communication platform built on foundational networking principles. Utilizing low-level TCP sockets and multi-threading for concurrent client management, the system ensures seamless message delivery backed by an interactive Tkinter graphical user interface.

projects.title: Satisfy (Spotify Clone)
projects.description: A full-stack music streaming web application designed to replicate core Spotify features and user interactions. Built using a modern JavaScript stack with Vue.js on the front-end and an Express and MongoDB back-end, it integrates real-time communication powered by WebSockets.

projects.title: InvestingHelper Platform
projects.description: A tailored financial calculator and advisory platform built specifically for a paying client. Engineered to deliver a frictionless experience across all devices, it features precise calculations and a streamlined user interface developed with React and TypeScript.

projects.title: Restaurant Management System
projects.description: A comprehensive object-oriented management model designed to streamline complex restaurant operations. Developed from the ground up in C#, it enforces advanced software engineering principles, clean code semantics, and robust architectural best practices.
